# Monet AI

> > Monet AI is a comprehensive AI video and image generation platform featuring cutting-edge models like Seedance, Hailuo AI 2.3, Runway Act-Two, and Kling AI for creating animations, effects, and cinematic content.

Monet AI aggregates state-of-the-art generative AI models from ByteDance, MiniMax, Runway, and other leading providers into a unified platform. The service supports text-to-video, image-to-video, motion capture, and specialized video effects across multiple languages, with integration to Video Arena leaderboards and Discord communities.

## Key Topics

- Seedance (ByteDance AI video model)
- Hailuo AI 2.3 (MiniMax video generator)
- Runway Act-Two (motion capture)
- Kling AI (video generation with Motion Brush)
- Flux (image generation)
- Video Arena (model benchmarking)
- Text-to-video generation
- Image-to-video transformation
- AI video effects and animations
- Photo-to-video conversion
- Action figure transformation
- ASMR video creation
- Cinematic long-take videos
- AI animation tools
- Multi-model comparison

## Core AI Video Models

- [Seedance - AI Video Generator | #1 Video Arena Model](https://monet.vision/es/seedance): ByteDance Seedance AI video generator, ranked #1 on Video Arena leaderboard with advanced text-to-video and image-to-video capabilities
- [Hailuo AI 2.3 - MiniMax AI Video Generator](https://monet.vision/fr/hailuo-ai): MiniMax Hailuo AI 2.3 video generator with enhanced text-to-video and image-to-video transformation features
- [Hailuo AI 2.3 - MiniMax Video Generator (DE)](https://monet.vision/de/hailuo-ai): German version of MiniMax Hailuo AI 2.3 with comprehensive video generation capabilities
- [Runway Act-Two - Next-Gen Motion Capture Model](https://monet.vision/runway-act-two): Advanced motion capture model for transforming performance into character animation with precise tracking
- [Kling AI Video Generator (DE)](https://monet.vision/de/kling-ai): Kling AI video generator featuring Motion Brush and keyframe animation controls

## AI Image Generation

- [AI Image Generator | Online AI Art Tool](https://monet.vision/zh/image-generator): Comprehensive AI image generator with text-to-image and image-to-image transformation capabilities powered by Flux and other models

## Video Effects & Transformations

- [Action Figure Video Generator](https://monet.vision/video-effects/action-figure): Transform people into action figures and anime collectibles with AI-powered video effects
- [Action Figure Transformation (ZH)](https://monet.vision/zh/video-effects/action-figure): Chinese version of action figure transformation video generator
- [AI Air Kiss Video Generator](https://monet.vision/video-effects/ai-air-kiss): Create air kiss and flying kiss videos and GIFs from static photos
- [AI Concert Cheating Video Generator](https://monet.vision/video-effects/ai-concert-cheating): Transform photos into realistic concert performance videos
- [AI Concert Cheating Generator (ZH)](https://monet.vision/zh/video-effects/ai-concert-cheating): Chinese version of AI concert video generator for creating fake concert performances
- [AI Birthday Video Maker (PT)](https://monet.vision/pt/video-effects/birthday-video-maker): Portuguese birthday video creator with personalized animations and music
- [Long-Take Video Generator (FR)](https://monet.vision/fr/long-take): AI-powered cinematic long-take video generator for continuous shot effects

## Tutorials & Guides

- [How to Use Seedance for ASMR Videos (ZH)](https://monet.vision/zh/blogs/how-to-use-seedance-asmr): Tutorial on creating low-cost glass fruit cutting ASMR videos with Seedance AI
- [Seedance ASMR Video Tutorial (KO)](https://monet.vision/ko/blogs/how-to-use-seedance-asmr): Korean guide for creating glass fruit cutting healing videos with Seedance
- [AI Model Comparison Guide (ES)](https://monet.vision/es/blogs/model-comparison): Spanish guide to using Monet AI's multi-model comparison feature
- [Blog Articles (ES)](https://monet.vision/es/blogs): Spanish blog with tutorials, insights, and guides for AI video generation
